title: Staying in Love for a Life of Victory
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner explores the game-changing truth that love is the greatest attribute a believer can possess, and when cultivated, it will never fail. Learn how to tap into the love of God that's already within you and discover the secret to overcoming the enemy's devices. As you listen, be prepared to be equipped with a love that will conquer all and destroy the enemy in Jesus' name.
